label: Modal root wiring
summary:
Modal root wiring (owner direction 2026-11-07). Finding: the necessary-being route's NecessaryAt m.ontic w n is literally the Kripke box of TruthCore.Modal.Kripke over m.ontic.frame applied to the existence atom (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl); the route needs no frame condition, so its necessity is in logic K, and no bridge identifies it with modal necessity. Certified a sense fork over 'necessary' (TruthCore.Causality.NecessarySenseFork): nine senses (box-existence K possibilist, actualist K, de dicto K, KT, S4, KTB, S5, tertia via 'cannot not-be' with diamond possibility, per se) with NecessaryIn by cases; per-branch theorems; joint fork theorem with OPEN coverage (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE), exclusivity as a choice of one reading (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSE-UNIQUE) and side conditions (STMT-NECESSARY-INTENDED-SENSE-SUPPORTED); root route NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK with the sense as parameter; nine strengthens registrations (S5->S4->T->actualist K->K->de dicto/tertia; S5->KTB->T; per se->tertia), using axiomT_valid, s5_implies_s4, s5_implies_ktb; controls with frame laws (axioms T, 4, B, Euclidean) and separations (T vs S4, actualist vs possibilist, de dicto vs de re, per se vs tertia) and one nonvacuity model. By-product (not modal): the two conjuncts of the met common-ground commitment STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS registered as strengthens to STMT-CAUSERS-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-AT and STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-REQUIRES-CONCRETENESS-AT, which establishes both and lowers NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE from 60 to 59 (ADOPTED-POTENCY 59 to 58). Rejected leads: (a) lowering the cheapest route (cost 30) with modal results: every leaf there is sourced/supported and proved from open premises, so only establishment lowers cost; modal results are premise-free certificates over specific frames while root vocabulary is parametric, so any modal derivation of a root leaf needs an open bridge (relocation, no cost drop). (b) Deriving STMT-GOD-IS-ETERNAL or STMT-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE from modal necessity: worlds are complete histories; box-existence across histories gives neither everlastingness nor changelessness (#469), so no modal theorem discharges them. (c) Defining MerelyPossible modally to make STMT-MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT analytic: it closes one leaf only by strengthening STMT-LACKING-ESSE-IS-MERELY-POSSIBLE to claim possibility of every non-actual candidate (false for impossibilia); not pursued. (d) Modal rival defence (#462 modal collapse, necessitism, #535 fixed history, #437 symmetry): no recorded alternative_to of any root-route premise is modal; recording a modal rival and refuting it with a premise-free model would defend nothing honestly (a refutation needs the rival's negation from established premises, and only eight floor items are established). No per-sense refutes relation applies: each failing branch fails by countermodel (non-entailment), not by refutation of a rival statement. Existence-consumer follow-up (2026-11-08): boxKToActualistK reverses the existing actualist-to-box edge without any extra premise: RootFacts already includes ActualRoot and hence ExistsAt of the same witness. Bare box-existence alone still fails to imply actuality in the explicit Unit candidate/empty existence/no-edge fixture; positive root nonvacuity reuses the existing fixture. Rejected: add reflexivity or a universal domain-to-actuality bridge to this consumer; both are unnecessary strengthenings. DISAMB-EXISTS still has legacy duplicated Box declarations, so this consumer result does not finish the global existential taxonomy, coverage/exclusivity, or its typed senses. No passage from arbitrary ExistsAt to act-in-esse is inferred. See specs/existence-sense-route.toml. PR1254 review repair: the initial bridge incorrectly targeted NECESSARY_11 (Frame). Corrected to append NECESSARY_12 with sense label NECESSARY_12 and stipulative definition 5bd704bb-4915-4657-9801-022247312147, reusing the already distinct, transparent NecessaryRootActualistK declaration. Source NECESSARY_2 is NecessaryAt, not a frame. Removed incidental Frame definition links from the two consumed K root nodes and synchronized their originating spec. Existing labels and identities remain unchanged. The scoped batch studies these two concrete readings; no unnamed alternative is a blocker.

Rotating-bearer comparison (2026-11-09): reused exact Control.swapOntic and Solution.certificate, rather than minting another de-dicto/de-re countermodel. Proposed general classification over the existing nine-constructor Sense enum in specs/rotating-bearer-sense-comparison.toml: under RotatingExistence, NecessaryIn s x iff s=deDictoK, retaining one profile, accessibility, rigid candidate identity and existence meaning throughout. Explicit ExcludedMiddle is retained for the general converse from cannot-not-be to box-existence; no hidden classical axiom. perSe additionally denies a distinct cause of necessity but already includes cannot-not-be; that conjunct suffices for exclusion. RootClassification keeps RootFacts as an independent existential obligation and derives no divine identity, attributes, immutability or eternity from population. Existing UnderivedRootRoute.rotating has ExistsAt=True everywhere with changing grounding edges, so rotatingSupport is not this rival. Existing modal witness-scope/degree controls concern varying causal possibility witnesses/intensities, not exchange of existential and box quantifiers. Rejected: infer all rivals false from one model; infer de-dicto population supplies a God witness; infer stronger S5 accessibility alone supplies a fixed existent. Controls reuse populated Bool swap on universal access (S5), plus the fixed unit model omitting no-common-bearer. Essence-based Scott/Goedel/filtered necessity remains outside enum as a named gap: NECESSARY_7 is FilteredNecessaryExistence, NECESSARY_8 is Box. OPEN applicability burdens: rigid transworld identity, history/world interpretation, existence valuation and coverage/exclusivity of intended readings. Conditional comparison is not independent defense of these meanings and closes no root premise. Connection target: STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-ON-INTENDED-READING on NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK. Missing bridge to truth: route inputs and independent RootFacts, not population. Verification is reported by delivered-head PR checks; this attempt does not assert proof success from seeded artifacts.
blocker: Route cost of the sense-fork route is 62 (the 59 of NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE plus the three OPEN fork premises: coverage, exclusivity, side conditions). The remaining NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE leaves are the 16 bare and 16 supported premises listed by frontier --routes; none is modal in content except the world-indexed bridges (LACKING-ESSE-IS-MERELY-POSSIBLE, MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT, OCCURRING-THOUGHT-OCCURS-AT-WORLD, ESSE-CAUSES-EXIST-AT), which are parametric bridges a Kripke theorem cannot discharge without fixing their predicates.
